verdict.rationale: Notte ships its own web agents that take natural-language tasks and carry them out on websites, as described in the GitHub README, the homepage ("Describe a task. Watch it happen."), the agent-start API, and a guide example prompt. A single community report of a failed extraction on hyatt.com raises reliability doubts but does not show the delegation capability is absent. missing for 10: documentation of an in-product conversational assistant UI beyond the API/SDK agent, independent hands-on corroboration of successful task delegation.
